node.statement: Scalar conclusion from the preceding two nodes: if x=||J_{P,Q,n}(Z)||/||Z|| for Z nonzero, then x^2||u_Q||=||Z^dagger dot Z||/||Z||^2. With the bounds of the preceding node, choosing e so that Be<=1/2 and (A+B)e<=1 gives (1-(A+B)e)<=x<=1+(A+B)e; the assertion is trivial for Z=0. Thus C_col=A+B works.
